project_info.name: Karat
project_info.target_audience: B2B - Jewelers, Custom Jewelry Designers, and Luxury Jewelry Stores
project_info.value_proposition: Turn website browsers into high-value custom jewelry clients with an interactive 3D ring configurator, virtual AR try-on embed, and integrated jeweler CRM.
project_info.selected_theme: Option B: Dark Onyx Hero with Warm Gold Accents, transitioning into Ivory/Light Editorial Sections

headings.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif tracking-tight leading-[1.1]
headings.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif tracking-tight leading-snug
headings.rule: DO NOT use Inter or standard sans for headings. Use elegant serif for luxury authority. Maximum size text-6xl.

meta_code.usage: Embed code snippets, CAD metrics, carat weights, hallmarking specs

bento_grid.grid_classes: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 lg:gap-8

components_to_build.name: KaratLogo
components_to_build.description: Original SVG brand mark featuring a geometric faceted diamond/karat silhouette in gold gradient.

components_to_build.name: Navbar
components_to_build.description: Sticky floating crystal glass bar with backdrop-blur-xl, Karat SVG logo, links (Features, How it Works, AR Fitting, CRM, FAQ), and Early Access waitlist button.

components_to_build.name: HeroSection
components_to_build.description: Onyx black dark hero with warm gold spotlight glow, kinetic masked line-by-line headline reveal, subheadline, interactive waitlist email form with toast notification, and 3D ring showcase tilt card with metal/gem selectors.

components_to_build.name: EditorialMarquee
components_to_build.description: Slow drift editorial ribbon with categories: Virtual 3D Fitting • Real-Time CAD Pipeline • Custom Embed Snippet • B2B Jewelry CRM • Photorealistic Renders.

components_to_build.name: HowItWorksPipeline
components_to_build.description: 3-step interactive flow showcase: 1. Copy 1-Line Embed -> 2. Client Designs Ring & AR Try-On -> 3. Jeweler Receives High-Intent Lead & CAD File in CRM.

components_to_build.name: BentoFeatureGrid
components_to_build.description: Asymmetrical feature grid showcasing 3D Configurator, AR Virtual Camera Try-On preview, Jeweler CRM lead board, Code Snippet generator, and conversion metrics.

components_to_build.name: ForJewelersMetrics
components_to_build.description: B2B performance section showing 3.4x conversion lift, 80% reduction in consultation back-and-forth, and client satisfaction metrics.

components_to_build.name: FAQAccordion
components_to_build.description: Clean collapsible Radix accordion covering embed installation, CAD export compatibility (MatrixGold, Rhino), custom branding, and early access pricing.

components_to_build.name: FinalCTACard
components_to_build.description: High-impact dark luxury card with gold tracing border effect, compelling waitlist headline, email capture form, and instant confirmation state.

components_to_build.name: Footer
components_to_build.description: Minimal luxury footer with large ghosted wordmark, navigation categories, social links, and copyright.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Follow Option B theme strictly: Dark Onyx Hero section (#080A0F) with warm gold lighting, transitioning smoothly into ivory/warm beige light sections (#FAF8F5).
Use Cormorant Garamond or Playfair Display for all major headings. Never use Inter for main headings.
Add explicit data-testid attributes to all interactive forms, buttons, inputs, and toggles.
Ensure smooth hover states, micro-interactions with framer-motion, and sonner toasts on waitlist submission.
Do NOT use pure #000000 or full transparent header backgrounds.
